Hi Evan —

Thanks for the heads up. We can support a short, provisional uplift without a formal committed amendment. I ran this with Jordan (billing) and Ben (solutions) and we sketched two options: a conservative no-commit provisional path and a staged uplift path with modest discounts for higher volumes. Attached is a simple pricing_tiers_v2.xlsx with the banded rates. High level: 

Option A — Provisional (no commit, instant enable):
- 0–250k extra tokens/day: +$0.012 / 1k tokens
- 250k–1M: +$0.009 / 1k tokens
- >1M: +$0.0075 / 1k tokens
- Activation: $0 one-time
- Billing: pro-rated on next invoice; overrun billed as usage (no retro true-up expected if provisional)

Option B — Staged uplift with short commit (7–14 days):
- 0–250k: +$0.010 / 1k tokens (10% off provisional)
- 250k–1M: +$0.0075 / 1k tokens
- >1M: +$0.006 / 1k tokens
- Minimum: $1,000 provisional minimum for the window (applied to invoice if consumption below)
- Grace: one-time 10% credit if you exceed projected peak in the first 48 hours while configs are tuned

Operational notes:
- We can flip the uplift on within 2 hours for the requested window and revert automatically at the end date you provide.
- We will enable additional rate-limiter headroom; temporary quota will be applied to your account.
- If you prefer committed short-term terms (Option B), we need an LOI by COB Wed to guarantee the staged discounts.

Next steps: if you approve Option A we can enable it now and bill as usage. If you want Option B, please sign the attached provisional MOP (acme-mop-provisional.pdf) and I’ll route to billing for the minimum and discount to be recorded.

I included the pricing spreadsheet and a proposed mutual action checklist in the attachment.

—

Naomi —

Thanks for the fast reply and for laying out both paths. A couple quick clarifications from our side before we lock:

1) The >1M band is the primary ask — our peak estimate is ~1.2–1.6M extra tokens/day for the peak 36 hours. Would you be willing to set a temporary cap with step pricing where the first 1M is billed at the 1M band rate and anything above 1M billed at the >1M rate? That would make our forecasting simpler.

2) For Option B, can you reduce the $1,000 minimum to $500 for a 7–10 day window? Our finance team is sensitive to minimums for short marketing tests.

3) About the 10% grace credit — is that applied automatically or is it a one-time manual credit after you validate the spike? We prefer automatic protection during the first 48 hours to avoid surprises if tuning is slower than expected.

If those three can be accommodated we can sign the provisional MOP today and confirm a start window of Monday 8am PT for a 72 hour window.

Appreciate it — Evan
